_comment: C0-17 正文英译 · assemblyai（2026-10-26）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」4 行带 .md 链接（deepgram/whisper/otter/chatgpt），related 写 4 条（frontmatter related 是 [deepgram, whisper, chatgpt]，键按正文链接行对齐=4——otter 行在正文但不在 frontmatter）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 带「实测建议」三条段。

axes.model_access: A self-developed unified speech-understanding model line (best-seller narrative: one model transcribes + understands, official site); hosted-API form, developers do not pick bare model weights.
axes.runtime: API/SDK as the main entry (REST + WebSocket + SDKs, official docs surface); pre-recorded file transcription is the traditional strength, with real-time streaming endpoints alongside (official docs).
axes.local_files: Cloud API — audio uploaded via the API; data-retention policy per the terms (not verified item by item); the official site carries a "not used for training"-type promise narrative (seen on the site), terms-level details not verified item by item.
axes.background: Batch (file → result polling/webhook) + real-time streaming, two forms; no "keep-running-after-shutdown" concept (API service).
axes.tools: Transcription + speaker diarization + summarization + topics/entities/sentiment and other understanding-layer parameters (fully listed in official docs); the LeMUR line (post-transcription LLM Q&A/extraction, official docs narrative) — "transcription + understanding" in one is its differentiating narrative.
axes.context: APIs have no memory concept; LeMUR Q&A over existing transcripts is "an LLM over transcript artifacts", not product memory.
axes.permissions: API key + usage billing (D9: pricing not collected); enterprise-compliance narrative (SOC2/HIPAA-type certification lines seen on the site, details not verified item by item); data-retention/training switches per the terms (not verified item by item).
axes.fit: Fits: developers building "transcription + understanding" pipelines (summarization/extraction/Q&A in one step), English-leaning high accuracy, teams that prioritize documented developer experience. Does not fit: non-developers using it directly, privacy-sensitive audio (cloud), Chinese-first usage.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **LeMUR Q&A recall quality over long-meeting transcripts**
- **Speaker diarization's actual behavior in Chinese meetings**
- **The terms-level landing of the "not used for training" promise** (DPA original text)
unknowns:
- Data-retention and training-clause details (not verified item by item)
- Chinese model-tier status (not verified item by item)
- Enterprise-compliance certification list details (not verified item by item)
related: The two titans of transcription APIs: Deepgram is strong on real-time streaming, AssemblyAI strong on the understanding layer.
Open-source-base contrast: the accuracy gap between AssemblyAI's transcription base and Whisper-class open models needs self-testing.
End-product contrast: Otter serves end users directly, AssemblyAI serves the people building products.
Understanding-layer contrast: AssemblyAI's LeMUR and "dump the transcript into ChatGPT for a summary" are two roads to the same need.
